description: Patch a campaign's SETTINGS — name, schedule, stop condition, compliance toggles. True PATCH: only the fields you pass are written. This works while the campaign is ACTIVE, unlike the sequence itself (steps and copy need a pause first). ⚠️ There is no `status` field: pausing and stopping are their own tools, and arming is not on this surface at all.
